title: Amelia Earhart: Flying Alone
subtitle: 考点：勇气与梦想 / courage, admire, above all
passage: Amelia Earhart dreamed of flying. At the time, few women were pilots, but she did not give up. She took flying lessons and worked at different jobs to pay for them.

In 1932, she flew alone across the Atlantic Ocean. She was the first woman to do it, and people around the world admired her courage. A few years later, she tried to fly around the world, but her plane disappeared over the Pacific Ocean. Nobody knows exactly what happened, but she still inspires many young people, above all girls who want to be pilots.
